verdict.rationale: A tax agency could plausibly offer a programmatic filing or licensing API, so this axis applies. However, every documented workflow (licensing wizard, excise-tax returns, amendments, payments, penalty waivers) runs through the My DOR web UI, the phone line, or mail. Probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec and no llms.txt, and the transactional host sits behind an authenticated login wall, so nothing shows API parity with the UI.
